title: Says you must enter a PIN or scan a QR to receive money
why: You never enter a PIN or scan a QR code to receive money. Doing either sends your money out. This is the trick behind most OLX and marketplace payment fraud.
examples: I have sent the payment, just scan this QR code to receive Rs 5000.
Approve the collect request and enter your UPI PIN to receive the advance.
PIN is required to receive money in your account.
safe: Scan this QR code to pay Ravi Kumar Rs 500.
You have received Rs 500 from Ravi Kumar via UPI.
